test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Teacher, Guitarist, Lawyer
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Some Teachers can be guitarists

Some teacher can be lawyer

Some lawyer can be guitarists

Some teachers can be guitarists as well as lawyers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18486e1ab1c9cfbec347ccb3c9415c0a8ef35c827d8a22c756f69307f760ca70.png] 

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
